class.name: NetwQuantizeTransform2D
class.brief_description: [NetwQuantize] that composes [Transform2D] from origin, rotation, and optional scale quantizers.
class.description: [member origin_quantizer] writes [member Transform2D.origin]. [member rotation_quantizer] writes [method Transform2D.get_rotation]. [member scale_quantizer] writes [method Transform2D.get_scale] when present. Skew is not encoded. An unset origin or rotation encodes through a stock quantizer, so a fresh instance encodes without any configuration. A transform whose parts were never declared would otherwise write nothing and decode to identity. The stock is not the member's value: both read [code]null[/code] until something assigns them. [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeTransform2D.new() q.origin_quantizer = NetwQuantizeScalar.new() q.rotation_quantizer = NetwQuantizeAngle.new() [/codeblock]

members.member: Quantizer for [member Transform2D.origin]. Unset, the origin encodes through a stock [NetwQuantizeScalar] spanning [code]-2048[/code] to [code]2048[/code] in steps of [code]0.5[/code].
Quantizer for [method Transform2D.get_rotation]. Unset, the rotation encodes through a stock [NetwQuantizeAngle].
Optional quantizer for [method Transform2D.get_scale]. Left unset, scale is not encoded and decodes as one.
